components.css: .ds-cover{background:#121844;color:#f3ead5;padding:2.5rem 2rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;column-gap:2rem;font-family:'Aref Ruqaa',serif}.ds-cover-title{margin:0;font-weight:700;font-size:3rem;line-height:1.12}.ds-cover-sub{margin:.75rem 0 0;color:#cdd1ea}.ds-cover-mark{font-weight:700;font-size:7rem;line-height:.85;color:#2c3366}.ds-contents{grid-column:1/-1;list-style:none;margin:2rem 0 0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid #454c7a}.ds-contents li{border-bottom:1px solid #454c7a}.ds-contents a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.5rem 1fr auto;gap:1rem;align-items:baseline;padding:1rem .5rem;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .25s}.ds-contents a:hover{background:#1d2452}.ds-contents a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f3ead5;outline-offset:3px}.ds-num,.ds-type{color:#cdd1ea;font-size:.95rem}.ds-t{font-weight:500;font-size:1.4rem}

narrative.overview: One writer's Arabic night journal, set like a modernist Beirut poetry review: seasonal issues and thematic dossiers, a novel bound inside it, midnight ink on warm grained paper, Ruq'a calligraphy for titles and Amiri for reading, with a faint sky as the only ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight ink on warm vintage paper with real grain
Ruq'a calligraphy titles, Amiri reading text, Noto Naskh labels
Each cover carries its own constellation
A chapter reader that keeps the reader's place

rules.name: Paper Everywhere
rules.body: Every ground and field carries the paper grain.

rules.name: Calligraphy Titles, Naskh Reads
rules.body: Ruq'a for titles, Amiri for reading, Noto Naskh for labels.

rules.name: No Label Above a Heading
rules.body: Issue lines, chapter numbers and dates sit below titles.

dos: Do keep the paper grain under every ground and field.
Do use Arabic-Indic digits and the Arabic comma.
Do draw ornaments as authored SVG.
donts: Don't add arabesque borders, tile patterns or gold-on-green.
Don't pair the crescent with a star.
Don't add a second accent, gradients or glow.
Don't put a kicker above a heading.
